claim: If you configure reserved concurrency on a function that processes an SQS queue, the guide says to set a minimum of five concurrent executions to reduce the chance of throttling errors when Lambda invokes the function.

qualifiers.scope: per function with an SQS event source mapping
qualifiers.condition: when reserved concurrency is configured; a recommendation, not an enforced limit

note: adjudicate-18: kind changed from default to behavior; the quote is a recommendation, not a default value.
